name: looming-demo
research_question: Does a deterministic looming input produce a time-varying response in the selected backend?
hypothesis: The backend output changes during the looming interval relative to its pre-stimulus baseline.
success_criteria: The run records baseline, stimulus, and recovery intervals on one simulation clock.
The exact neural input and selected backend output are saved for every neural step.
This demo protocol is not evidence of biological validity.
notes: Scaffold parameters only. Stimulus geometry, retinal mapping, neural dynamics, and behavior have not been calibrated against biological measurements.
